source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital platforms" AND (city OR cities OR urban) AND (governance OR space OR labour OR labor OR housing OR regulation)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital platforms" AND (city OR cities OR urban) AND (governance OR space OR labour OR labor OR housing OR regulation),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital platforms" AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "urban") AND ("governance" OR "housing" OR "labor" OR "labour" OR "regulation" OR "space"))
